**Column-B (Group number in the Modern Periodic Table)**

Alkali metals

options.text: i - a, ii - b, iii - c, iv - d
i - a, ii - c, iii - b, iv - d
i - b, ii - a, iii - c, iv - d
i - d, ii - c, iii - b, iv - a

solution:
The correct answer is __**i - d, ii - c, iii - b, iv - a.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The common names mentioned in column A are the names of the** groups** in the **Modern Periodic Table.**
 
• **Alkali metals** are **highly reactive metals **that belong to **Group 1 **of the Modern Periodic Table.
 
• **Alkaline earth metals** are also highly reactive metals that belong to **Group 2** of the Modern Periodic Table.
 
• **Halogens **are **non-metals** that are highly reactive and belong to** Group 17** of the Modern Periodic Table.
 
• **Noble gases **are **non-reactive gases** that belong to **Group 18** of the Modern Periodic Table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **chemical elements** are arranged into **rows and columns** on the periodic table, also known as the **periodic table** of the elements.
 
• When the chemical elements are arranged in this way, a recurring pattern in their properties known as the **"periodic law"** occurs, where elements in the **same column** (group) have **similar properties. **
